name: mark
title: Mark
description: A stroke of highlighter over the words that matter.
use: The part of a result that matches a search, or a phrase a reviewer points at, on a native mark. It means "relevant here"; for importance use strong.

instead.when: The words name a person, a team or an issue
The words are literal text such as a command or a file name
The words are a status or a count beside a label

classes.name: mark
classes.description: A wash of ink behind the words, in the color of the text around it

classes.name: mark-brand
classes.description: A wash of the brand color, for the one phrase a page is about

classes.name: mark-underline
classes.description: A thick stroke along the foot of the words instead of a wash over them

states.name: current
states.description: The match a reader has stepped to among several: it fills with ink

example: Phases of the moon, a field guide
